headline: Share India Securities issues ₹50 cr in senior secured NCDs on private placement basis
sum: Share India Securities' Finance Committee approved issuance of ₹50 crore in senior secured, rated NCDs (50,000 instruments of ₹10,000 face value each) on private placement, under SEBI (LODR) Regulation 30 material event disclosure.
implication: Private placement of listed senior secured debt by a tier-2 broking firm demonstrates cost-of-capital access in the corporate debt market; the absence of disclosed coupon/tenure/security cover suggests deal structure was under negotiation at announcement.
detail: Share India Securities Limited, a tier-2 equity broking and financial services firm, received board-level approval via its Finance Committee on 18 June 2026 to raise ₹50 crore through the issuance of 50,000 senior secured, rated, taxable NCDs of ₹10,000 denomination each, to be listed on a debt segment (BSE or NSE). The securities are transferable and redeemable. The mandatory disclosure was filed under SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, Regulation 30 (material events). As of the announcement, pricing, coupon rate, tenure, security cover, lead arranger details and the specific debt exchange were not disclosed.
